source: 「RE4 溶解流光半透明材质」会话 2026-11-05 的回复（RE4 3.5 片段源码）；四个溶解模板含义一致

note.zh: 溶解进度由 AVM 的过渡控制；这里调的是溶解的方式和发光。像素在进度 ≥ 1 − m 时溶掉，m = (溶解图通道 + 噪声权重 × 噪声) / (1 + 噪声权重)
note.en: AVM's transitions drive the progress; these set how it dissolves and glows. A pixel is gone when progress ≥ 1 − m, m = (map channel + noise weight × noise) / (1 + noise weight)

note.zh: 关闭后溶解完全不起作用
关闭时用 UV1；噪声图始终用 UV1
note.en: Off uses UV1; the noise map always uses UV1

note.zh: 以进度为单位，常见 0.12～0.2；0 = 不发光
note.en: In progress units, usually 0.12–0.2; 0 means no glow

note.zh: 常见 2.5～5。lilToon 版再乘自发光单位（LIL_Light.z），半透明版再乘发光总强度（LIL_EmissionParam.w）
note.en: Usually 2.5–5. Multiplied by the emissive unit (LIL_Light.z) on lilToon, by the emission total (LIL_EmissionParam.w) on the transparent material

note.zh: lilToon 版按数值连续减弱（1 = 完全关闭）；半透明版 ≥ 0.5 即关闭
note.en: lilToon fades it continuously (1 = off); the transparent material turns it off at ≥ 0.5

note.zh: 0 = 只按溶解图推进；越大越碎。常见 0.4
note.en: 0 follows the dissolve map only; higher is more broken up. Usually 0.4

note.zh: 0 = 整条带发光，1 = 只在噪声格的轮廓上发光。常见 0 或 0.6
note.en: 0 lights the whole band, 1 only the noise cell outlines. Usually 0 or 0.6

note.zh: Dissolve 模板：噪声沿 U 的滚动速度（UV/秒），常见 0。AnimDissolve 模板：发光动画速度，0 按 1 处理
note.en: Dissolve templates: noise scroll along U (UV/s), usually 0. AnimDissolve templates: glow animation speed, 0 counts as 1

note.zh: Dissolve_Map 的 R / G / B 分别是身体 / 手臂 / 腿的先后（值越高越先切换）；B > 0 的像素算腿，否则 G > 0 算手臂，其余算身体。各部分把自己的进度映射到下面的区间里
note.en: Dissolve_Map R / G / B order body / arms / legs (higher switches first); B > 0 is leg, else G > 0 arm, else body. Each part maps its progress into the ranges below

note.zh: 反向溶解时代替起点 / 终点使用
note.en: Used instead of start / end when dissolving in reverse

note.zh: 手臂进度 = max(身体进度 × 这个值, 手臂自己的区间进度)。常见 1
note.en: Arm progress = max(body progress × this, the arm's own range progress). Usually 1
